scope: Finish and saved-result/export validation require 38 family-target absence proofs and five package-boundary checks. The 35 explicitly named low-Vt RF records require no mandatory lvtn drawing, published CLVTNM mask/edit purposes, low-Vt identifier or candidate names/texts. Three bondpad records require absent pad drawing/mask/pin/label/intent. Five installed package drawing purposes are checked against each explicit module-cut polygon. All 286 tests pass per OS without skips; 29 retained controls agree across systems. All six complete-catalog replays agree, and three actual application runs plus Windows exports pass. Reference targets are absent: 438 executed, 657 absent, 90 W/L exemptions, eight advisory and 363 unresolved records. No present RF-device geometry, other pad-family selector, complete-chip boundary, required density or foundry acceptance is inferred. Native extraction and electrical results retain their original authenticated scope.

application.scope: Actual Runner export removes only the top-level prBoundary box matching the independent OpenDB die. Manufacturing masks and text are compared in full. Six partial geometry profiles, antenna, isolation, OpenDB checks and macro export rerun on the corrected GDS. Original timing/equivalence remains separate; no new extraction, full physical signoff or installer qualification. The retained 45-record core context is supplemented by 37 explicitly absent label, named-cell and raw-layer subjects; present subjects require further review. Four new VPP geometry checks execute, with absent capacitor targets on these references. Density observations do not establish density acceptance. Forty-four new module/seal interaction checks execute. Missing module or seal geometry does not establish complete-chip context. Thirty-six selected device requirements are measured: VPP, pwell resistor and PNP absence requires no drawn markers or candidate names/labels; two implant geometry checks execute with absent targets in these references. Four conservative bounds and eighteen raw IP blockage subjects are freshly checked; failed sufficient bounds and present blockages remain unreviewed. Seven floating-net records are freshly checked against physical device roots, without pin endpoints or exception labels. Seven special-device subject absences require empty relevant drawn/mask operands, merged nwell holes and conservative intent guards; present candidates stay unreviewed. The full corrected reference catalog remains retained separately; this run does not rerun the complete catalog. Eighteen new sufficient frame bounds stay unreviewed because the reference blocks lack frame and die-cut markers. Seal origin and width are measured on explicit 81:1 markers, which are absent in these reference blocks. No complete-chip boundary qualification is inferred. Fourteen drawn-layer scribe size bounds execute on all connected features without inferred junction context. Three drawn-well sufficient bounds execute with absent targets. Sixteen selected pad, inductor and implant targets are conservatively checked for absence; nonempty targets remain unreviewed.

boundary_export.scope: Remove only the single top-level prBoundary box equal to the OpenDB die, if present. All other forbidden boundary-purpose input is rejected; manufacturing shapes and annotations are preserved.

family_targets.scope: Thirty-five diff.13 messages explicitly name sky130rf_nlowvt devices. The published F2a nlowvt family requires drawn lvtn; the GDS table identifies 125:44 as the low-Vt NMOS device purpose. Empty lvtn, all published CLVTNM mask/edit purposes, low-Vt identifier, and no low-Vt/RF cell or text hints establish this family absent. This is not a numerical RF geometry pass, recognition of present RF devices, or a substitute for the missing fixed-layout model map and Table H5. Three messages explicitly target bondpad existence or opening: C3 defines bondPad as pad:dg OUTSIDE areaid:ft. All pad drawing, mask, pin, label, center and frame guards and intent hints must be empty. Present or ambiguous subjects remain unreviewed, even when enclosure layers are missing. Other RF families and pad variants are not covered.

package_boundaries.scope: Five package-layer scribe.7 records use the pinned installed SKY130 layer map, which explicitly supplies their drawing purposes. Each connected drawing region is checked against every disjoint module-cut polygon on 81:10. A positive-area portion on each side is a crossing; pure contact or full containment is allowed. Missing module markers do not establish complete-chip boundaries. These bindings do not establish package availability or accept any other package, enclosure, spacing or generated-mask requirement.

seal_geometry.scope: Drawn areaid.sl on 81:1 is merged across reachable hierarchy. For a single connected marker, its lower-left bounding-box corner must be (0,0); disconnected markers require origin review. All merged seal geometry must meet the catalog minimum width of 6 um, including ring walls. The manual x.28 N/A is not treated as a waiver of finite error record r392. Absence is recorded separately and does not establish a complete seal or chip. No advanced-seal cell selector or diffusion-overlap exemption is inferred. Only Manhattan geometry, exact orthogonal paths and unit orthogonal hierarchy on a 1 nm grid are supported.

scribe_bounds.scope: Fourteen drawn-layer scribe.5 records use a global sufficient size bound. After flattening reachable hierarchy and merging all touching/overlapping fragments, every connected feature must have at least one bounding-box side strictly below 10000 nm. Such a feature cannot contain a 10-by-10 um region at any location or orientation, so none can occur within 150 um of any scribe junction. A feature at exactly 10000 nm on both sides is a candidate. Large boxes, including thin L shapes and rings, stay unreviewed: bounding-box size does not prove a wide region or a nearby junction. No junction, frame, die or chip boundary is inferred. Empty drawing geometry is recorded separately. Generated-mask companion records and complete scribe context remain unreviewed; this report does not establish full physical coverage or process qualification.

well_bounds.scope: Three drawn-well sufficient bounds use the finite error-catalog requirements; the manual N/A entries are not waivers. All drawn PWDE expanded by a 1000 nm square must fit within both DNWELL and UHVI. Every pair of holes in the fully merged drawn PWBM must be at least 840 nm apart in the square metric. Holes are collected before any UHVI selection, so clipping cannot manufacture new holes. Hole hulls include nested islands conservatively. All drawn PWBM must lie within UHVI, without applying the LOWVTID exception. Equality passes; missing enclosing geometry cannot waive a nonempty target. A failed stronger bound stays unreviewed, not a foundry violation. Empty targets and fewer than two holes are separate absent-operand decisions. These checks do not establish device completeness, full-chip context, generated-mask equivalence or process qualification.

frame_bounds.scope: Eighteen exact drawn-layer frame records use a sufficient 3000 nm square-margin proof. The complete target union expanded by [-3000,3000] in both coordinates must fit within supplied areaid.ft for enclosure, or have zero positive-area overlap with supplied areaid.dt for spacing. Equality passes. No blanking or named-cell exception is applied. A failed square bound is unreviewed, not a foundry violation. Missing boundary context leaves a nonempty target unreviewed. Empty targets are recorded separately. Supplied markers do not establish complete-chip context. Generated masks, dummy diffusion, frame completeness and all other requirements remain separate.

selected_targets.scope: Sixteen exact catalog targets have conservative absence proofs. BondPad is a subset of pad:drawing under the published C3 definition; the complete drawing and additional pad/mask/intent guards must be empty. The generic pad name must end before another ASCII letter; explicit pad compounds and bond names retain substring matching. These name hints supplement the mandatory raw drawing checks and do not recognize devices by name alone. Every captured inductor family requires the inductor drawing identifier; all identifier/terminal/label data and candidate names must be absent. For r1476, empty poly AND tap implies empty Var_channel and therefore an empty selected well target. For r1493, an absent HVI region makes ndiff inside HVI empty, with additional voltage/mask/intent guards. Missing enclosing metal or implant is never an absence proof. Nonempty or ambiguous targets remain unreviewed. ViaTop, hugePad, other pad variants, generated-mask recipes and device qualification remain separate; no nonempty numerical rule execution is claimed.

special_subjects.scope: Seven catalog obligations have conservative empty-subject proofs only. An entirely absent UHVI region cannot be straddled by any selected geometry. Deep-well enclosure requires the deep-well target itself absent, including explicit mask data. Precision-resistor and RPM-selected subjects require empty RPM, URPM, CRPM and poly-resistor purposes. The nwell-hole angle subject requires no holes in the merged nwell and no explicit nwell mask or extended-drain markers. Candidate cell names or labels prevent the associated proof. Nonempty subjects stay unreviewed; source N/A values are not used as waivers. Nonempty rule meanings and complete device qualification remain separate, including the catalog/manual depmos.8 and urpm.3 naming differences.

device_roots.scope: Every merged routed poly/LI/metal component is traced through every contact level to gate (poly AND diff) or diffusion/tap outside poly. Pin shapes, text, standard-cell markers and exception labels cannot supply endpoints or connectivity. Every submitted conductor/root area must be accounted for. Unrooted components leave the selected catalog messages unreviewed; a legal IP feedthrough is not automatically a foundry violation. Capacitor/RDL/cut/short edits and float/tie declarations prevent this proof. Dummy-fill purposes, device/body correctness, electrical behavior and complete physical qualification remain separate.

conservative_bounds.scope: Four catalog limits are satisfied only when broader drawn-geometry checks pass: all merged NSDM and PSDM widths at least 380 nm, and all merged poly spacing/notches at least 210 nm. No core-gap or opposite-parallel exception is used. A failed sufficient bound is unreviewed, not a claimed violation of the narrower foundry rule. Eighteen IP blockage obligations are absent only when their exact published block purposes contain no raw data. Present blockages remain unreviewed; generated routing operands and hierarchy semantics are not implemented. Generated masks, global grid/density and complete physical coverage remain separate.

selected_devices.scope: Thirty-four VPP, pwell-resistor and PNP catalog records are absent only when their mandatory drawn purpose has no raw shapes and no reachable cell name or label suggests the device. Present candidates remain unreviewed. Separately, each gate (poly AND diff) overlapping tunm must be enclosed by tunm by 95 nm, and every drawn hvntm region must be inside hvi. Gates outside tunm are not selected by this enclosure check; their spacing and device intent remain separate. A SONOS name or label with no gate or with unselected gates keeps r453 unreviewed. Generated implants and complete device/density qualification are not established.

boundary_interactions.scope: Thirty-five published drawn-layer purposes are checked for straddling each supplied module-cut polygon on 81:10. Diffusion is checked for straddling seal 81:1; tap, poly, li1 and met1-met5 are checked for positive-area seal overlap. Targets are merged connected regions. Boundary polygons must be disjoint and non-touching so merging cannot hide an internal boundary. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths are supported. Missing boundary geometry does not establish chip/frame completeness or waive any enclosure or spacing requirement. Five package-layer scribe records remain separate.

catalog_context.scope: Thirty-three explicitly core-selected geometry messages and one core-approval message require absence of all raw areaid.ce data; three LDNTM messages require absence of the actual implant subject. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Eight boundary prohibitions are checked directly. This is not complete catalog coverage or memory-device qualification.

catalog_labels.scope: Thirty-seven literal catalog messages are resolved only by complete absence of their selected label, named-cell or raw-layer subject. Labels are searched on every purpose and through the hierarchy; case, Unicode compatibility, whitespace and embedded-token variants conservatively prevent absence. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Unmarked floating nets, redundant vias, chip part-number requirements and the construction of module/frame regions remain separate.

vpp_geometry.scope: Selected rules on merged capacitor drawing 82:64: 1.43 um minimum width, no straddling nwell or dnwell, and 1.5 um enclosure for capacitors overlapping nwell. An outside-nwell capacitor leaves the enclosure requirement unreviewed; missing nwell never proves exemption. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths. Density operands are measured per connected capacitor region without selecting device exceptions or claiming density acceptance. Other VPP rules remain separate.

Boundary polygons must be disjoint and non-touching so merging cannot hide an internal boundary. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths are supported. Missing boundary geometry does not establish chip/frame completeness or waive any enclosure or spacing requirement. Five package-layer scribe records remain separate.

catalog_context.scope: Thirty-three explicitly core-selected geometry messages and one core-approval message require absence of all raw areaid.ce data; three LDNTM messages require absence of the actual implant subject. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Eight boundary prohibitions are checked directly. This is not complete catalog coverage or memory-device qualification.

catalog_labels.scope: Thirty-seven literal catalog messages are resolved only by complete absence of their selected label, named-cell or raw-layer subject. Labels are searched on every purpose and through the hierarchy; case, Unicode compatibility, whitespace and embedded-token variants conservatively prevent absence. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Unmarked floating nets, redundant vias, chip part-number requirements and the construction of module/frame regions remain separate.

vpp_geometry.scope: Selected rules on merged capacitor drawing 82:64: 1.43 um minimum width, no straddling nwell or dnwell, and 1.5 um enclosure for capacitors overlapping nwell. An outside-nwell capacitor leaves the enclosure requirement unreviewed; missing nwell never proves exemption. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths. Density operands are measured per connected capacitor region without selecting device exceptions or claiming density acceptance. Other VPP rules remain separate.

application.restored_boundary_rejected: Forbidden SKY130 boundary-purpose data remains in the delivered GDS. Recheck Finish/export.

limitations: The 38 family decisions are absence proofs, not numerical passes for present RF devices or bondpads.
The remaining RF family selectors, fixed-layout model map and Table H5 remain unresolved.
Package drawing bindings come from the authenticated installed layer map, not new published-foundry definitions.
Missing module-cut geometry does not establish complete-chip boundaries or waive enclosure/spacing.
The full catalog replay is reference-specific; arbitrary jobs still do not have complete physical signoff.
Generated masks, frame/scribe construction, other pad selectors, pin spacing and required density remain open.
Native extraction, nominal voltage, timing and equivalence remain authenticated retained dependencies.
